hook: Four people were trapped in their attic as the flood kept rising.
narration: Four people were trapped in their attic as the flood kept rising.
This is Sumas, Washington, during the historic floods of December 2025.
The water around their house was eight to ten feet deep.
Crews on the ground could not reach them.
So a Coast Guard Dolphin crew from Port Angeles sent their rescue swimmer down the cable.
The swimmer rides the hook down, [short pause] then the crew lowers a steel basket for one person at a time.
He helped them out through a window in the attic.
Then the basket started coming back up, full.
outcome: Two Coast Guard crews hoisted all four people out of the flood, and no injuries were reported.
title: Trapped in the attic as the flood rose
description:
Coast Guard helicopter crews hoisted four people from a flooded home in Sumas, Washington, after rising water forced them into their attic during historic flooding in December 2025.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Port Angeles, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/989916/coast-guard-northwest-river-flood-rescues
